items.title: Trucking Booking Solutions
items.text: Build an on-demand truck booking app that will allow users to book a single truck of a fleet of them for their logistic purposes.

items.title: Carpooling App
items.text: Bring together car owners and passengers sharing the same route and travel timings with a carpooling app.

items.title: Hire a Bike
items.text: Kick off an on-demand bike rental business that allows users to connect to bike fleet owners and vice versa.

items.title: Tow Truck app
items.text: Create your own Uber for tow trucks that can be of aid for roadside assistance.

items.title: Airport Taxi
items.text: Airport shuttles are hard to find and difficult to book. An airport taxi booking app can make things simpler for all.

items.title: Bus Booking
items.text: An on-demand bus booking app that allows users to book seats or entire buses for their personal/professional purposes.
